blocks.title: A plan whose title is long enough to wrap onto a second line at the desktop width

tasks.title: A task whose title is also long enough to wrap onto a second line in the plan

elements.text: This sentence is here to make the text long enough to wrap onto several lines at the desktop width, and further still on a phone, so the wrapping, the line height and any truncation Slack applies all show. It goes on a little longer, past three hundred characters, which is where long text starts to behave differently.
